score.prompt: Epic dark Nordic fantasy film score, 90 seconds, instrumental only, no vocals except wordless distant female choir. 0-14s: deep sub-bass drone, slow war drums, low cellos, ominous and vast. 14-25s: drums build, horns rise, then one huge orchestral hit at 20s. 25-36s: everything drops away; a gentle five-note lullaby melody on a solo nyckelharpa, tender and fragile. 36-53s: dread, low tremolo strings and a slow heartbeat drum rising in tension. 53-63s: near silence, one held high violin note. 63-74s: the lullaby returns in full, warm strings and soft female choir, emotional and triumphant. 74-87s: dark turn, low brass, war horns, pounding drums, rising to a peak. 87-90s: silence.
